A black gaming laptop sits open in front of her. She holds a smartphone, scrolling and smiling at the screen, occasionally pointing with her index finger. Behind her is a light gray brick wall, a gray sofa with orange pillows, and a large potted green plant. (2) The scene transitions to a digital screen capture of the Apple App Store, displaying an application titled 'Focus Traveller'. Then, it cuts to an animated interface featuring a white cartoon dog with a yellow hat and blue backpack walking through a stylized dark blue forest with tall trees. (3) The animation continues, showing the dog character sitting by a campfire at night, then lying down to rest as a system notification appears at the top of the frame. The woman returns to the frame, holding her phone to show a group-focus interface with various cartoon animals. (4) The visuals switch back to screen recordings of the app's settings menu, showing sliders and selection grids for characters, music, and time durations. Finally, an over-the-shoulder shot shows the woman typing on her laptop while her phone rests on the table with the app active. She turns toward the camera, smiling and speaking directly to the viewer.
